title: A Magyar Köztársaság kikiáltása (Proclamation of the Republic (October 23, 1989))
grammar: Constitutional Proclamations, Negotiated Democracy & Sovereign Historical Registers

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say when and by whom the Republic was proclaimed.
I can say whose anniversary the proclamation fell on.
I can explain in a simple sentence what popular sovereignty means.
I can use the accusative -t to say what was proclaimed or declared.
